body: Explore the future of AI Management
Powered by the Autonomous Service Workforce, the Outcome AI™ Platform gives AI access to the work wherever it happens, handles deeper work, and self-improves with every outcome.
The best source of information for customer service, sales tips, guides, and industry best practices. Join us.
AI agents have changed how users access software. The ripple effect is that product and engineering teams need to deliver insights, actions, and outcomes through experiences they don’t control.
How we're modernizing the foundations of Zendesk analytics to make business data more accessible, flexible, and ready for AI.
How Zendesk Bridge brings service context and capabilities to the AI interfaces people now use.
What happens when your AI products evolve faster than your pricing model? Here's what we learned from changing ours three times.
Learn how Zendesk's Unified Retrieval Platform provides a shared foundation for AI knowledge, ensuring consistent answers across AI agents and human support.
Bring Zendesk workflows into the Microsoft Copilot Cowork experience and give agents built with the Microsoft Copilot Studio platform governed access to Zendesk capabilities through Zendesk Bridge™️
Zendesk Unlimited introduces Outcome AI Platform Plans, giving businesses more flexibility to expand AI across service, with no per-seat charges and spend tied to eligible outcomes.
Learn how autonomous AI agents resolve service requests, take action across systems, and operate within defined business rules.
Learn how self-improving AI agents use feedback and customer interactions to improve service quality, resolve more issues, and reduce manual work.
Learn how outcome-based pricing ties AI investment to measurable results, so businesses can evaluate value based on what agents achieve, not just what they cost.
From proof of concept to one million executions, discover how Zendesk and Anthropic are bringing AI into complex customer service workflows.
A practical customer success plan guide: what to include, how to build it, and how to keep customers aligned from onboarding to renewal.
Learn how an AI-powered ticketing system turns customer requests into trackable tickets so teams can route, prioritize, and resolve issues faster.
A customer success playbook standardizes onboarding, adoption, renewals, and expansion with clear triggers, steps, and metrics to improve retention.
ITIL explained simply: how the framework improves service reliability, SLAs, and customer satisfaction, plus ITIL 4 basics and certification.
Explore what employee onboarding is, how long it lasts, and how to build a repeatable process that boosts engagement and time-to-productivity.
Get a clear view of your organization’s tech landscape to reduce risk, save time, and boost employee productivity with IT asset management (ITAM).
Learn about the top 10 change management models and methodologies to help your team successfully navigate organizational shifts.
Follow these call center tips to improve customer satisfaction, reduce agent burnout, and boost productivity.
Call centers handle inbound and outbound calls at scale. See how they work, key roles, types, and how they improve CX.
A cloud-based call center is a more convenient alternative to traditional call centers for many small businesses. Learn how they work and who can benefit below.
Customer satisfaction is key to your business success.
Feedback forms help you collect opinions from customers, stakeholders, and employees. Download our free templates and collect feedback today.
Use these customer service email templates to provide faster and more consistent responses to customers.
You need an actionable customer service philosophy to provide great service. Here’s how to create one that stands out and a free template to get started.

2,000 global IT leaders and employees shared their insights on how IT service management is evolving to meet the challenges of the AI revolution and increasing employee expectations.In this infographic, you'll discover the top seven insights you need to know.
Want to take a deeper dive? Choose a topic.
Discover the five trends defining the era of AI Management and what they mean for the future of customer experience.

Do Not Sell or Share My Personal InformationWe do not sell your personal information in exchange for monetary value. However, Zendesk may share your personal information with other companies that support our business, such as marketing and advertising partners. This exchange may be considered a “sale” or “sharing” under California law, and you have the right to opt out of this “sale” or “sharing” of personal information. Please use the below options to opt out of the use of your personal information for “sale” and "sharing" purposes, as defined by California law.
